description: The develop planner schema (fabro-9ec3 arm 3 pattern) for the loop lane: routing contract with preferred_next_label restricted to this node's outgoing edge labels, plus the gate-command ban — a current_seed_brief naming the PRODUCT gate (`just qualitygate` / `nu scripts/qualitygate.nu`) or the LOOP gate (`nu .fabro/workflows/loop/scripts/loop-gate.nu`) fails validation and burns an output retry.
